Companion Animal Travel Desk: care and acceptance guidance

This section sets out how we prepare, review, and hand over companion animal bookings with calm, careful service. We keep safety ahead of speed, and we make sure each traveler receives clear guidance before departure so the trip feels orderly from start to finish.

At the desk, staff confirm the booking details, the carrier condition, and the pet's general readiness before any acceptance step is completed. If a cat file is reviewed, <<FACT F079>> The record is then checked for consistency, and any gap is sent back for correction before travel is allowed to move ahead. We speak in simple terms, stay patient with questions, and avoid rushing anyone through the process.

For dogs and other approved animals, the carrier must be secure, clean, and fit for safe handling by the ground team. If a small dog crate is reviewed, <<FACT F068>> The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and we expect everyone involved to handle each item with steady hands and respect for the animal inside. When a traveler arrives with a pet such as Thor, we keep the tone reassuring and remind the traveler to follow the listed checks before boarding.

The desk also tracks special care notes so the right support is available from booking through pickup. If a pet appears unwell, stressed, or poorly restrained, the shift coordinator may pause acceptance and request a fresh review. We do not make exceptions that weaken safety, and we do not rely on guesswork when a condition needs attention. Clear handoff notes help the next team member continue the service without confusion.

For any unclear case, contact the shift coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
